mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the FEDFUNDS rate increases by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month signals a weakening labor market, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where UNRATE rises by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals a weakening demand, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where RSAFS declines for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in a month signals a strong supply-side response, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO increases by more than 2% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment (CPIAUCSL growth < 1% YoY) combined with a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 2%) signals accommodative monetary conditions, which boost equity valuations and lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where CPIAUCSL YoY growth is < 1% and FEDFUNDS is < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in a month signals a weakening labor market, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where PAYEMS declines by more than 100,000 in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% over three months signals a strong demand for housing, which boosts related sectors and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where HOUST increases by more than 10% over three months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) by more than 2% over two consecutive quarters signals a strong economic expansion, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where GDPC1 increases by more than 2% over two consecutive quarters.
